old_reuse_requires: r04 independent raw physics/public audit PASS

empty_stack_minmax_score: max occupied public rank + 1; above unknown tail 22

policies.OLD_FROZEN_R: Deduplicate by first action and keep its minimum requested-h source; frozen four-coefficient delta; H0 is the same-solver baseline/fallback and is replaced only for strict negative nonzero delta; preserve selector (delta,h) ties.
policies.R_SOURCE_FULL: Keep all five requested-h source rows including duplicate destinations; apply the frozen full-source selector; no EG group commitment.
policies.R_UTILITY_RIDGE: Shared frozen 74D Ridge; deduplicate first actions; same solver H20 is anchor; only a strict lower score replaces it; exact score ties retain anchor and lower alternatives tie by destination index.
policies.R_QUAD_H: Use frozen q-to-H quadratic rule and invoke only its selected horizon.
policies.R_ORDER_MAIN_TAU0_FULL: Shared frozen 20x5 rates; score the deduplicated pool of five native first actions plus one legal one-step risk proposal; tau=0; only a strict lower score replaces same-solver H20; score ties by destination index.
policies.NATIVE20: Call the same new solver at H=20.
policies.model_input: Public frame and action only; solver identity, proposal source, evaluator truth and private IDs are not model features.
policies.group_commitment: None for the three new solvers; every policy returns exactly one legal destination per decision.

noise_protocol.forecast_pairing: One fixed forecast per layout-condition shared across all six new policies and three new solvers.

statistics.overall_score: Equal mean of seven within-solver macro R_raw improvement percentages; each method uses its own native H20 baseline.
statistics.layout_weight: 20 layout clusters are the statistical sampling unit.
statistics.noise_family_weight: Three noisy families equally weighted; CLEAN reported separately.

bootstrap.five_R_pairwise_familywise_ci: Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided interval for 10 pairs; quantiles 0.0025 and 0.9975

statistics.winner_claim: No unique overall winner without registered interval support.
